description: An abstract Java class implementing a downstream message sender for the Eclipse Hono project, utilizing Vertx-Proton for message publishing.

classes.name: AbstractDownstreamSender
classes.description: An abstract class for sending messages downstream in the Hono framework, based on Vertx-Proton.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message with device ID, payload, and content type, returning a Future of ProtonDelivery.

methods.name: addProperties
methods.description: Adds device ID as a property to the message.

methods.name: getCharsetForContentType
methods.description: Determines the charset from the content type string, defaults to UTF-8.
